authoritative_key.why_this_is_the_key: The commit, not the version. A version string is a label that moves when someone remembers to bump it, and this file demonstrates exactly that: the tree at 82e31eb was SIX COMMITS PAST the v1.1.0 tag and pyproject.toml still read 1.1.0 at both. So this sweep did not measure the v1.1.0 release, it measured six commits of work on top of it under a version string that had not been bumped yet. Quoting '1.1.0' without the commit is the same error results.json made with 0.1.0, one level up.
authoritative_key.recovery_method: The sweep recorded no commit. Its own recorded_at is 2026-09-28T19:07:29+00:00 (2026-09-29 03:07 local) and the commit timeline has a gap spanning that moment: 82e31eb is 2026-09-28 18:25 local, 53c5b21 is 2026-09-29 08:39. One commit can have been HEAD in between. A lower bound, not a proof -- the tree at that moment need not have been clean.

identity.dataset_sha256: NOT RECORDED, and unrecoverable. run_comparison.py requires data/b100m.xml, b1g.xml and b4g.xml to exist and skips any that do not; it never hashed them, never recorded the generate command or its seed, and all three have since been deleted. gigaxml generate is a pure function of (seed, size, namespace) and is byte-reproducible -- measured, two runs at the same seed are identical -- so the bytes are recoverable in principle, but the SEED THAT PRODUCED THESE FILES was never written down, and an unrecorded seed cannot be guessed from a digest. This is the one field the milestone's invariant cannot supply for this file, and it is why benchmarks/provenance.py now records seed and digest together.
identity.memory_method: peak_wset (self-read in child) -- as recorded, and it was TRUE for this sweep, which is decidable rather than assumed: results.json records os 'Windows 11' and on win32 psutil's memory_info() has peak_wset, so the wrapper took the peak branch and not its 'or info.rss' fallback. It was still a hardcoded string at the time, so nothing in the code guaranteed it; run_comparison.py now has the child report which counter answered and the recorder store that instead of asserting it.
